fixes.summary: 离线双标签页回归先按完整存档字节等待原生存储传播，再执行旧人物动作；增加写入页自身的防覆盖断言。
fixes.effect: 保留旧人物内存状态、防覆盖、原档保留、错误提示、导出和刷新断言，不用固定延迟掩盖失败。
fixes.verification: Native Chromium reproduced a stale other-tab read after a completed write. Removing the save guard only in a temporary generated bundle still fails the strengthened regression.
fixes.limitation: This repairs a test synchronization precondition; it does not add a cross-renderer atomic localStorage lock.

fixes.summary: 旧页面 retry/resume 先校验显示中的物理档案 ID；冲突时阻止读取回应、生成请求、attempt 写入及另一人物的死亡结算。实时导入后先同步会话再续接。
损坏离线目录提供原文导出；明确确认后先持久备份并读回完整原文，再保留可读取旅程并恢复目录。
fixes.effect: 检测到旧数据冲突、备份失败或写入失败时，不替换当前人物；坏目录原始字节继续可恢复。

New-character drafts remain separate from the active save until confirmed and durably saved.

The offline single-file build remains available with no runtime dependencies.

Two independent live journeys were created and retained their pending opening states.
Legacy offline life and both live journeys coexist in the journey chooser.

blockedOrUnverified: A new real AI opening and choice did not complete while the provider account returned its actual free-quota exhaustion error.
Generated-history switching in production could not be exercised without a generated opening.

Offline HTML and a later offline export download path did not yield actual files for independent byte checks; the CLI HTTP attempt was blocked by DNS.
